Dark Reader 4.9.133, vendored from the official npm package `darkreader@4.9.133`.
https://github.com/darkreader/darkreader
MIT license: see LICENSE.

The unmodified browser bundle is imported as raw text and executed inside the isolated browser guest. Its API is kept in `window.__vesselDarkReader` to avoid replacing the website's own globals. No remote script loading is required.
